title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 8: the ark is brought into the temple and Solomon prays and blesses the people.

questions.text: In which month did all the men of Israel assemble to King Solomon at the feast?
questions.explanation: All the men of Israel assembled to king Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

questions.text: What was in the ark when it was brought into the house?
questions.explanation: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb.

answers.text: The book of the law and a jar of manna

questions.text: Why could the priests not stand to minister?
questions.explanation: The cloud filled Yahweh's house, so that the priests could not stand to minister, for Yahweh's glory filled the house.

questions.text: Where had Yahweh said he would dwell, according to Solomon?
questions.explanation: Solomon said, "Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness."

answers.text: On the top of Mount Zion
In the light of the sun

questions.text: According to Solomon, whom did Yahweh say would build the house for his name?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told David it was good that it was in his heart, but his son who would come out of his body would build the house.

questions.text: What does Solomon say cannot contain God?
questions.explanation: Solomon said, "Heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain you; how much less this house that I have built!"

answers.text: Heaven and the heaven of heavens

questions.text: What does Solomon ask God to do when a foreigner comes from a far country and prays toward this house?
questions.explanation: Solomon asks God to hear in heaven and do all that the foreigner calls for, so all peoples may know his name.

answers.text: Send him back to his own land
Hear and do all that the foreigner calls for
Let him pray only outside the gates
Require him to become a priest

questions.text: From what position did Solomon arise when he finished his prayer?
questions.explanation: When Solomon finished praying, he arose from before Yahweh's altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

questions.text: How many head of cattle did Solomon offer as peace offerings?
questions.explanation: Solomon offered twenty-two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep as peace offerings.

questions.text: How long did Solomon and all Israel hold the feast?
questions.explanation: Solomon held the feast with all Israel before Yahweh seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.
